title: The Fifth Declension
subtitle: rēs, diēs, fidēs. The e-stems.
objectives: Recognize -ēs nominative singular as fifth-declension marker.
Understand that most fifth-declension nouns are feminine.

sections.heading: The fifth declension
sections.body:
Fifth-declension nouns end in -ēs. Most are feminine. Paradigm (rēs, reī — thing):

  Sg: rēs, reī, reī, rem, rē
  Pl: rēs, rērum, rēbus, rēs, rēbus

Common: rēs (thing, affair), diēs (day, m./f.), fidēs (faith, f.).

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can decline fifth-declension nouns.
